The primary subject in the foreground is a large, laterally compressed angelfish with a vibrant blue body and yellow tail (likely a Queen Angelfish). Behind it, partially obscured, is another fish exhibiting the black anterior and yellow posterior coloration characteristic of a Rock Beauty. Several smaller, silvery fish swim in the background near wooden structures.
